beginner.title: Get started with Andela Talent
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Andela Talent, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: A profile that gets noticed
beginner.outcome: You can: create a strong profile on Andela Talent

beginner.title: Find the right opportunities
beginner.outcome: You can: search and filter effectively
beginner.practice: Save three searches and set alerts

intermediate.title: Apply or pitch well
intermediate.outcome: You can: write applications that win
intermediate.practice: Send three tailored applications or proposals

intermediate.title: Pricing, terms and safety
intermediate.outcome: You can: agree fair terms and stay safe
intermediate.practice: Draft your rate card and terms checklist

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Andela Talent
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Andela Talent distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Andela Talent
expert.outcome: You can: use Andela Talent's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Build reputation
expert.outcome: You can: grow repeat work and referrals
expert.practice: Turn one completed job into a case study

expert.title: Integrate Andela Talent into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Andela Talent with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Andela Talent to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Andela Talent well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Andela Talent" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
